# Ekko documentation

> Ekko helps Teams and Individuals understand onchain activity and make informed decisions. People control transaction execution.

These Markdown pages are generated from the same articles as the public documentation. Read each page's availability and limitations before using its instructions.

## Documentation

- [Ekko documentation](https://ekko.zone/docs/index.md): Understand Ekko, choose your audience, and evaluate the scope of an integration.
- [Documentation changelog](https://ekko.zone/docs/changelog.md): Changes to the public documentation library and its availability statements.
- [Product concepts](https://ekko.zone/docs/concepts.md): How monitoring, intelligence, and proposed actions serve people within a clear scope.
- [Delivery proof model](https://ekko.zone/docs/delivery-proof-model.md): Separate the trigger, affected cohort, expected notification, possible action, and impact.
- [Individuals](https://ekko.zone/docs/guides/individuals.md): Understand direct Ekko use and keep it separate from provider subscriptions.
- [Teams](https://ekko.zone/docs/guides/teams.md): Choose between serving provider subscribers and monitoring separately supplied wallets.
- [Developer integrations](https://ekko.zone/docs/integrations.md): Evaluate an integration against its audience, coverage, consent, and delivery contract.
- [Troubleshooting](https://ekko.zone/docs/troubleshooting.md): Identify the affected relationship and collect useful evidence for a documentation or notification question.
